limitations: Source/caller conditions are declarations, not authenticated provenance or experimental control.
No load generator, endpoint calls, core/heap dump engine or causal/root-cause diagnosis.
Only selected numeric fields are normalized. Bodies, URLs, arbitrary names, environment, arguments and error messages are excluded; sanitize technical identity first.
Percentiles are retained per source population/policy; never averaged or added. Missing measurements remain null.

hs_err_pid contains sensitive process data. Only fatal signal, IDs, runtime version, elapsed time and bounded frame symbols/modules survive; no environment, command line, memory dumps or arbitrary messages.
Problematic/crashing frames are observations, not proof of root cause. Missing END. means partial_or_unknown; a marker is not a completeness authentication.
